projectDescription: A C library function that reads one line at a time from a file descriptor, with a bonus variant supporting multiple simultaneous file descriptors.
keyFeatures: Reads one line at a time from any file descriptor
Configurable buffer size via BUFFER_SIZE compile-time macro
Static leftover buffer preserves unread data between calls
Bonus variant supports up to 10240 simultaneous open file descriptors
Zero external dependencies — only stdlib.h and unistd.h
Proper memory management with no leaks on error paths
